summary.text: Brad Barker is a Republican member of the Montana House of Representatives from District 55, where Ballotpedia lists his tenure as beginning in 2023, and a business owner and U.S. Army veteran seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Democrat Richard Gessling.

paragraphs.text: Barker was born in Altus, Oklahoma, and served in the United States Army from 1994 to 2014.

He earned a bachelor's degree from the United States Military Academy at West Point in 1994, a graduate degree from Georgetown University in 2004, and a graduate degree from the United States Marine Corps University in 2006.
His career experience includes being a business owner.
In the 2025-2026 session Barker was assigned to the House Rules Committee and the Appropriations Committee.
He advanced from the Republican primary on June 2, 2026.
